'''Gali''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who was a member of the [[Altisian Jedi]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Despite not being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Gali lived and trained with the [[Altisian Jedi]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sect that was led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> she traveled with the rest of the sect to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yarille]], where they carried out relief work.
